id: AT-QK-01 (0.1.6 queue contract: queue check, the example program, the reason cap)
note: The plugin shares its queue contract and tells how to integrate with its questions path: `queue check [<program>]` runs only list --json --session <made-up id> of the contract in assets/queue-contract.md (default: queue_cmd) and prints ok/FAIL per check with the fix, then QUEUE CHECK PASS (exit 0) or QUEUE CHECK FAIL <check> (exit 1); it writes nothing (no caps cache, no queue-state, nothing in the program's store) and never calls add or adopt. The shipped example assets/examples/queue-folder.sh passes it, queues a question end to end through queue-add (QUEUED, then EXISTS from its own store with the ledger gone) and lists it after. A reply without the tag, a reply with keys the schema refuses and a program that is not executable fail with their fix. /status prints the queue check pointer and the user-run line only while queue_cmd is set. queue-add caps recommendation_none_reason at 200 B whenever the draft carries it, also beside a recommended option (before 0.1.6 only when no option was recommended). Review fixes: the chmod fix names the full path, shell-quoted (a path under HOME printed as ~ inside quotes did not expand); a list reply whose session is not the id sent fails; a reply of exactly 256 KiB passes and one byte more fails; queue-add bounds the draft again after redaction, so a label the redaction marks grow past 40 B is refused, not sent; a blank recommendation_none_reason beside a recommended option is dropped and the question queued; a lane id that ends in a newline is no lane (no Queued: line); after redaction only the size caps run again, and a mark that takes the question's closing ? (SECRET=from_vault?) puts it back, so the draft is queued (0.1.6 review: it was refused as `question`)
